metadata.name: classify ticket, escalating when unsure
metadata.description: Classify one support ticket on a cheap model, and hand it to a stronger model only when the cheap one is not sure. The escalation step is declared first, so its category is the one read whenever it ran.

metadata.name: Escalate ticket classification
metadata.description: Classify a ticket the cheap classifier was unsure about, on a stronger model.

metadata.name: Classify ticket cheaply
metadata.description: Classify a support ticket's category and urgency, summarize it, and say how sure it is.
